subject: Post-demo: decision landscape sketch + internal ally asks
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Lina Torres <lina.torres@venturefin.com>, Marcus Hale <marcus.hale@venturefin.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 3 Dec 2028 15:04:00 -0800
Subject: Quick recap + next asks from today's demo

Thanks again for taking the demo today — appreciated the time, Lina and Marcus. Short recap (high level) and two asks so we keep momentum: 

What we covered
- Encoder/embedding pipeline fit for VentureFin use case (real-time scoring + batch re-ranks)
- Latency & cost targets you called out: 95th < 300ms for scoring, target cost <= $0.60 per 1k requests in pilot volumes
- Data residency concern for EU-sourced PII (Marcus flagged legal/compliance guardrail)

Decision landscape (as I understand it)
- Economic buyer: Marcus Hale (CTO) — will sign off on pilot budget
- Champion: Lina Torres (Product Lead) — will drive day-to-day evaluation and vendor fit conversations
- Compliance/Security reviewer: Ashwin Rao (Security) — will own SOC2 and data-flow signoff
- Procurement & Contracting: procurement@venturefin.com — handles PO/SOW redlines

Two asks to keep momentum: 
1) Lina/Marcus — confirm procurement and security contacts + their preferred turnaround for SOW/terms (we heard 2 weeks but want to confirm).
2) Lina — can you surface an exec one-pager (2 slides max) that would help Marcus/finance justify the pilot? If useful, we can draft and hand to you for quick edit.

Attachments: pilot-scope-v1.pdf (scope & metrics we discussed).

Next meeting: I sent a calendar hold for Dec 10 to review pilot SOW and the analytics success criteria.

Thanks — Jordan
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | +1 415 555 0142

From: Lina Torres <lina.torres@venturefin.com>

Cc: procurement@venturefin.com, Ashwin Rao <ashwin.rao@venturefin.com>
Date: Sun, 3 Dec 2028 17:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick recap + next asks from today's demo

Jordan — good summary, thanks. Confirming the decision map you listed. A couple of clarifications and requests from our side: 

Clarifications
- Marcus is the economic approver, yes. He will want a 6-month pilot budget estimate and an ROI sketch showing cost per 100k scored requests (and expected latency improvement vs current infra).
- Ashwin needs a short evidence pack: SOC2 summary, data-in-transit/encryption detail, and a brief on tenant isolation for pilot data (we'll need to present to legal).
- Procurement wants the SOW and standard T&Cs; turnaround expectation is ~10 business days for initial SOW review.

Requests from our side
- Jordan/Redwood: please draft a one-page exec brief (clear ask + top-line ROI bullets) that Lina can hand to Marcus. A 2-slide deck is even better.
- Security: can you provide the SOC2 summary and a note on deletion/retention policy for pilot data? If you have a template evidence pack, attach.

We are aligned on the Dec 10 check-in. I'll invite the finance lead to that session once we have an exec brief.

Lina
Lina Torres
Product Lead, VentureFin
lina.torres@venturefin.com

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 4 Dec 2028 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: INTERNAL: Prep for VentureFin exec brief + security asks (quick tasks)

Kimberly / Ben — quick internal plan to cover Lina's asks and get us ready for Dec 10. Short tasks (can we triage by EOD PST today?):

1) Champion enablement (Kimberly) — Draft a 2-slide exec brief + 1-page ROI sketch tailored to VentureFin. Key numbers needed: ballpark monthly request volume (I'll pull from discovery), expected cost per 100k requests at pilot config, and a 6-month cost/benefit summary. Keep language exec-friendly (problem/ask/expected impact).

2) Security evidence pack (Ben) — Pull SOC2 summary, short encryption & KMS note, and retention/deletion language we can share. If we don't have a concise one-pager, assemble the three items into soc2-summary.pdf (1 page). Also confirm tenant isolation language for pilot (we support VPC/tenant separation).

3) Legal/Sales ops (Ben) — Please draft a minimal pilot SOW using redwood-pilot-terms-v1.pdf as the base. Procurement expects initial review in ~10 business days; we should aim to send by EOD Dec 6.

4) Deck + Deliverable (Kimberly) — I'll write a short email intro to Lina and attach the exec brief; we should include a 1-paragraph callout for Marcus showing the ROI assumptions and a single-line ask for approval (e.g., approve pilot budget $XXk).

Attachments to build: redwood-pilot-terms-v1.pdf (SOW template), soc2-summary.pdf (evidence pack).

I'll prepare the numbers and share them in a follow-up. If either of you needs a quick sync, I'm available at 10:00 or 11:30 PT.

Thanks — Jordan
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
